import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { Helmet } from 'react-helmet-async'; import api from '../../services/api'; import Loader from '../common/Loader'; const About = () => { const [about, setAbout] = useState(null); const [teamMembers, setTeamMembers] = useState([]); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); // ===================================================== // API BASE URL // ===================================================== const API_BASE_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:8000'; // ===================================================== // FETCH DATA // ===================================================== useEffect(() => { fetchData(); }, []); const fetchData = async () => { try { setLoading(true); const results = await Promise.allSettled([ api.get('/api/about/'), api.get('/api/leadership/active'), ]); // About if (results[0].status === 'fulfilled') { setAbout(results[0].value.data); } else { console.error( 'Error fetching about:', results[0].reason ); } // Leadership Team if (results[1].status === 'fulfilled') { const leadershipData = results[1].value.data; setTeamMembers( Array.isArray(leadershipData) ? leadershipData : [] ); } else { console.error( 'Error fetching leadership:', results[1].reason ); setTeamMembers([]); } } catch (error) { console.error( 'Error fetching About page data:', error ); } finally { setLoading(false); } }; // ===================================================== // IMAGE URL // ===================================================== const getImageUrl = (image) => { if (!image) return null; if ( image.startsWith('http://') || image.startsWith('https://') ) { return image; } if (image.startsWith('/')) { return `${API_BASE_URL}${image}`; } return `${API_BASE_URL}/${image}`; }; // ===================================================== // VALUES // ===================================================== const values = [ { icon: '🎯', title: 'Excellence', desc: 'Striving for the highest standards in education', }, { icon: '🤝', title: 'Integrity', desc: 'Building trust through honesty and transparency', }, { icon: '💡', title: 'Innovation', desc: 'Embracing new ideas and creative solutions', }, { icon: '🌍', title: 'Global Mindset', desc: 'Preparing students for a connected world', }, ]; // ===================================================== // LOADING // ===================================================== if (loading) { return ; } return ( <> About SC Academy - Our Story & Mission {/* ===================================================== HERO ====================================================== */}
